document.about: Two invented lines printed to PDF by headless Chrome on macOS (fixtures/chrome-type3-advances.html): Helvetica as CID TrueType, the ﬃ ligature and the CJK name in PingFang SC as Type 3 fonts. The second paragraph is set narrow so the name wraps after its first character.

notes: Reprint with: Chrome --headless --no-pdf-header-footer --print-to-pdf=chrome-type3-advances.pdf chrome-type3-advances.html, then update the sha256.

checks.issue: The Type 3 ﬃ was given a guessed width, measured to the next Type 3 glyph only, and the rest of its advance read as a space: offi ce.
checks.text: The office confirmed the order for 青松纸业有限公司.

checks.issue: The CJK name wrapped after its first character was joined with a space, 青 松纸业有限公司, and the full stop set apart.
checks.text: deliver the office chairs to 青松纸业有限公司.
